title: 八木節 (Yagibushi — The Yagi Song)
description: A lively traditional folk song from the Yagi inn town area (now Tochigi Prefecture), originally called 'Genta-bushi' after its legendary first performer 堀込源太 before being renamed at its 1914 recording. The song begins with a self-deprecating introduction ('またも出ました三角野郎が') and features rapid-fire vocal improvisation over a driving drumbeat, making it a staple at summer festivals and Bon dances across Kanto and Tohoku.
